title: Seoul weighs steps to force North Korea landmine apology
summary: SEOUL — South Korea is considering measures to force an apology from North Korea over a recent landmine blast that injured three soldiers inside the Demiltarized Zone, its defense ministry said…

blocks.text: SEOUL — South Korea is considering measures to force an apology from North Korea over a recent landmine blast that injured three soldiers inside the Demiltarized Zone, its defense ministry said Tuesday. A joint South Korean-UN investigation concluded that two landmines that exploded in the DMZ last month were planted by North Korean forces about a year ago, prompting Seoul to demand an official apology. It has also called on the nuclear-armed North to remove any other mines planted on the southern side of the Military Demarcation Line (MDL) that runs through the DMZ, the heavily fortified frontier that has divided […]...
